proposals.before: He assisted Eledengbao in breaking Ran Tianyuan and Zhang Zicong at Zhuyu Pass and was told to win over remnant rebels in Tongjiang and Bazhou.
proposals.after: Assistant [Grand Minister] Eledengbao broke Ran Tianyuan and Zhang Zicong at Zhuyu Pass and ordered Qing to win over remnant rebels in Tongjiang and Bazhou.
proposals.reason: Chinese 參贊額勒登保 is Eledengbao's title (Assistant), not a verb meaning Liu Qing assisted him.

proposals.before: He assisted Eledengbao in defeating Ran Tianyuan and Zhang Zicong at Zhuyu Pass and was ordered to pacify the remaining rebels in Tongjiang and Bazhou.
proposals.after: Assistant [Grand Minister] Eledengbao defeated Ran Tianyuan and Zhang Zicong at Zhuyu Pass and ordered Qing to pacify the remaining rebels in Tongjiang and Bazhou.
proposals.reason: 參贊 is Eledengbao's office title, not 'he assisted'.

proposals.before: In spring of the seventh year he routed rebels at Wufangping in Nanjiang, took chiefs Li Bin and Xin Wen, received vice censor rank, and was soon made Sichuan vice censor-in-chief.
proposals.after: In spring of the seventh year he routed rebels at Wufangping in Nanjiang, took chiefs Li Bin and Xin Wen, received surveillance-commissioner rank, and was soon made Sichuan provincial surveillance commissioner.
proposals.reason: 按察使 is provincial surveillance commissioner, not vice censor.

proposals.before: In the spring of the seventh year he defeated rebels at Wufangping in Nanjiang, captured the chiefs Li Bin and Xin Wen and others, was given vice censor rank, and soon appointed Sichuan vice censor.
proposals.after: In the spring of the seventh year he defeated rebels at Wufangping in Nanjiang, captured the chiefs Li Bin and Xin Wen and others, was given surveillance-commissioner rank, and soon appointed Sichuan provincial surveillance commissioner.
proposals.reason: 按察使 is not 'vice censor'.

proposals.before: After mourning his stepmother he left office; when mourning ended he became Shanxi vice censor, then provincial treasurer.
proposals.after: After mourning his stepmother he left office; when mourning ended he became Shanxi provincial surveillance commissioner, then provincial treasurer.
proposals.reason: 山西按察使 is surveillance commissioner, not vice censor.

proposals.before: He mourned his stepmother, left office, and after the mourning period was appointed Shanxi vice censor and then provincial treasurer.
proposals.after: He mourned his stepmother, left office, and after the mourning period was appointed Shanxi provincial surveillance commissioner and then provincial treasurer.
proposals.reason: 按察使 mistranslated as vice censor.

proposals.before: Liu the Blue Sky" was what the people of Sichuan called Qing.
proposals.after: "Liu the Blue Sky" was what the people of Sichuan called Qing.
proposals.reason: Literal English is missing the opening quotation mark before Liu.

proposals.before: In the Guangxu period he was posthumously given the temple name Zhuangsu.
proposals.after: In the Guangxu period he was posthumously given the posthumous name Zhuangsu.
proposals.reason: 追諡 marks a posthumous name (諡), not a temple name (廟號); the literal rendering wrongly calls 壯肅 a temple name.

proposals.before: Later he pacified Pinglong and fought at Huayuan, always in the army's van.
proposals.after: Later at Pinglong again, and fighting at Huayuan, he was always in the army's van.
proposals.reason: 平隴 is the place-name Pinglong parallel to 花園 Huayuan; 復平隴 is not the verb 'pacified', which the literal invents.

proposals.before: I urge the ancient garrison-farming system.
proposals.after: I foolishly think nothing is better than adopting the ancient garrison-farming method.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits 臣愚以為莫若 and reduces a comparative recommendation to a bare urge.

proposals.before: In the third year Xuanzong praised his long service in Shaanxi, his knowledge of the Southern Mountains, and local peace under his rule, granting vice censor rank as special honor.
proposals.after: In the third year Xuanzong praised his long service in Shaanxi, his knowledge of the Southern Mountains, and local peace under his rule, granting the rank of Provincial Surveillance Commissioner as special honor.
proposals.reason: 按察使銜 is Provincial Surveillance Commissioner rank, not vice censor.

proposals.before: In the third year Emperor Xuanzong, because Ruyi had long been in Shaanxi and knew the Southern Mountains well and since taking office the region had been tranquil, issued a special commendation and added vice censor rank to mark exceptional honor.
proposals.after: In the third year Emperor Xuanzong, because Ruyi had long been in Shaanxi and knew the Southern Mountains well and since taking office the region had been tranquil, issued a special commendation and added the rank of Provincial Surveillance Commissioner to mark exceptional honor.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 按察使銜 as vice censor in the literal field.

proposals.before: Governor Lu Kun added a department between Zhouzhi and Yang, more posts at Shangzhou and Lueyang;
proposals.after: Governor Lu Kun especially valued him, adopted his plan to add a department seat on the border of Zhouzhi and Yang County, and increased garrison posts at Shangzhou and Lueyang;
proposals.reason: Idiomatic drops 尤重之、採其議 and truncates 洋縣 to ambiguous Yang.

proposals.before: In the fifth year he was named Guizhou vice censor but never took office.
proposals.after: In the fifth year he was named Guizhou Provincial Surveillance Commissioner but never took office.
proposals.reason: 貴州按察使 is Provincial Surveillance Commissioner, not vice censor.

proposals.before: In the fifth year he was promoted Guizhou vice censor but did not reach his post.
proposals.after: In the fifth year he was promoted Guizhou Provincial Surveillance Commissioner but did not reach his post.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 按察使 as vice censor in the literal field.

proposals.before: By nature he was bold and free, cast off ceremony, indifferent to glory and profit, and treated them like a farmer or rustic elder.
proposals.after: By nature he was bold and free, cast off ceremony, indifferent to glory and profit, and appeared like a farmer or rustic elder.
proposals.reason: 視之如田夫野老 describes how he himself appeared, not that he treated others as farmers.

proposals.before: His son Zhengji, born Zhi, styled Shanfang.
proposals.after: His son Zhengji, originally named Zhi, courtesy name Shanfang.
proposals.reason: 原名 means original name, not birth; 'born Zhi' misreads the name formula.

proposals.before: He rose to prefect of Zhengzhou.
proposals.after: He rose to department magistrate of Zhengzhou.
proposals.reason: 知州 is a department magistrate (zhizhou), not a prefect (知府).

proposals.before: He was promoted prefect of Zhengzhou.
proposals.after: He was promoted department magistrate of Zhengzhou.
proposals.reason: 知州 is a department magistrate (zhizhou), not a prefect (知府).

proposals.before: After mourning his mother he took Fuzhou in Fengtian.
proposals.after: He returned home to mourn his mother; after the mourning period he was appointed to Fuzhou in Fengtian.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits 歸 and 服闋 (return home; appointment after mourning was completed).

proposals.before: He repeatedly acted as Huai-Yang intendant and vice censor.
proposals.after: He repeatedly acted as Huai-Yang intendant and provincial surveillance commissioner.
proposals.reason: 按察使 is the provincial surveillance/judicial commissioner, not a vice censor.

proposals.reason: 按察使 is the provincial surveillance/judicial commissioner, not a vice censor.

proposals.after: At that time the Yue rebels were rampant; commanders were at odds and the army long achieved nothing.
proposals.reason: In this Guangxi Xianfeng setting 粵匪 means the Yue/Taiping rebels rather than Guangdong-only.
